tree_boundary: Uncommitted environment/material/sky/perf/shadow-cache/resident-terrain work followed by the independent native spectral-sea slice. No commit or push. Initial native controls precede final resolved-dump/default-quality/invalid-budget edits and coefficient-bounded slope-moment storage. Packed release diagnostics below cover the final numeric storage. Older native controls remain integration evidence for the earlier tree, not final-shader frame timings.
scope: Render-only linear finite-depth spectral field, filtered optical slopes/moments, and bounded near-slot displacement shared by existing terrain raster, atlas and optional mesh-ray geometry. Not authoritative water physics, an exact displaced whole-planet ocean, or complete renderer parity.
hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Vulkan, Linux; native capture reports Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1

implementation.core: crates/render-core/src/ocean.rs: SI SeaState/Spectrum/Mode, seeded Gaussian Phillips shape, prescribed Hs normalization, omega^2=g*k*tanh(k*depth), Hermitian pairing, zero DC/Nyquist, f64 wrapped phases and direct-sum oracle. No backend dependency.
implementation.gpu: crates/render-wgpu/src/ocean*.{rs,wgsl}: nine band/plane layers, persistent evolution + row/column radix-2 inverse FFT, height/analytic slopes/scaled second-moment texture and reduction mips. Moment scale is coefficient-bounded and at most 1024; extreme slopes beyond the portable half-float envelope fail explicitly. No new dependency or upstream implementation copied.
implementation.mapping: Periods 2048/256/32 m; three body-fixed YZ/XZ/XY fields with smooth normalized radial^4 weights, including weight derivatives. CPU f64 camera residues keep phase independent of floating-origin subtraction and cube-face UV changes.
implementation.geometry: Existing 33x33 generated pool, no separate mesh or CPU expansion. Bounded datum backups are restored before recapture/deformation; height/source revisions supersede old backups. Admitted near slots retain a full grid and a coefficient-derived culling envelope; selected-slot BLASes alone rebuild after changed wave/fade/mask state.
implementation.admission: Existing tile AABB plus normalized-cube Hessian padding; potential sea-height range and configured distance/capacity. Whole near-partition overflow restores prior geometry and reports optical-only fallback. Geometry displacement fades from half radius to radius; sub-cell and far waves remain optical detail, not exact ray intersections.
implementation.materials: Existing world-addressed material directory, hierarchy/edge sampling and alpha roughness classify water versus land/ice. Material texture/directory publication conservatively invalidates the entire near set, even for unrelated far-page updates; localization remains future work.
implementation.optics: Raster and mesh RT hits share wave normals, scalar omitted/filtered slope variance, water IOR=1.333 and existing GGX kernels. Ocean raster samples the same environment publication as sky/meshes; no invented second sky. RT field footprint remains zero; no ray cones, environment convolution or anisotropic-covariance convergence claim.
implementation.state_time: Native gravity comes from baked body mu/radius^2. Presentation/authority simulation seconds drive phase. Unchanged paused samples skip FFT/deformation/AS/atlas updates. Rewinding is deterministic. Large phase jumps/rebases upload coefficients; upload spike cost is not separately benchmarked.
implementation.controls: RequestedGraphics.ocean -> ResolvedGraphicsSettings; graphics.toml/metadata/dump. Disabled by default. Low/Medium/High N=32/64/128 retain the same 128^2 reference sea state and omitted optical slope variance. Defaults: 16 near slots, 300 m radius; zero slots/distance is optical-only. Legacy Bevy remains analytic and runnable.

core: Finite-depth, shallow/deep and local-gravity special cases
gpu: Direct Fourier-sum height/slopes at N=16/32/64/128 for times 0,0.125,72000,-45,1e9 seconds
Steep Hs=20 m, wind=1 m/s input remains finite in base and terminal moment mips
Shared geometry absolute height envelope and no displacement accumulation
Whole near-partition overflow, datum restoration and recovery
Equal-resolution cube-face shared edge and camera-origin agreement within 2 mm
Coefficient envelope/full-grid classifier retains a deterministic interior crest beyond the old five samples
Mesh-ray results evolve with shared geometry/normals, paused frames need zero AS builds, and rewind is byte-identical

tolerances.bound_fixture: Displacement <= coefficient sum envelope +0.001 m rounding tolerance. Hs=2/seed=17 envelope 96.616082 m is intentionally conservative, not observed wave height.

correctness.limitations: Deterministic numeric/render oracles, not blind aesthetic acceptance. Render displacement/far-datum approximation is not an authoritative buoyancy/contact error budget.

field_cost.scenario: Nine layers; g=6.4 m/s^2, depth=100 m, wind=10 m/s, Hs=2 m, seed=17; 20 warmup and 120 measured simulation samples at 1/60 s. Paused final sample asserts zero dispatches.
field_cost.boundary: Three independent hardware command intervals: spectral evolution; two FFT passes; mip reduction. Host interval includes update/submit/completion but excludes query readback. Initial construction/coefficient upload is warmup, and phase-rebase upload spikes are unmeasured. Quality comparisons are different frequency sampling, not image-identical workloads or a renderer speedup.
field_cost.interpretation: Summing stage medians is not a measured total p50. Clocks/affinity are unlocked; the earlier run overlapped CPU compilation. Final run had no concurrent agent build/test job; observed variability prevents a stable tail/throughput or upstream-comparison claim.

near_geometry_and_ray_cost.scenario: High N=128 field, one mirror mesh, 1280x720, 16-slot backup capacity; one or 16 admitted adjacent patches. 20 warmup and 60 measured changed 1/60 s samples. Every measured frame asserts exactly the admitted number of terrain BLAS builds.
near_geometry_and_ray_cost.boundary: Separate hardware intervals for backup restoration/capture/deformation, AS builds including TLAS, and mesh/RT draw. Field FFT and CPU publication/queue writes precede these intervals. This is not a complete terrain raster/atlas/frame benchmark.
near_geometry_and_ray_cost.interpretation: Bounded shared near-slot rebuilding costs far less than the prior 1024-patch 73-74 ms all-BLAS case, but these are different admitted workloads, not a quality-matched renderer win. No every-frame whole-ocean rebuild strategy is adopted.

native_controls.shared: 1280x720, no HUD, 30 warmup plus 120 measured frames, silent audio environment. Sequential controls, not interleaved same-process A/B; clocks and asynchronous streaming are uncontrolled. Native GPU frame marks exclude earlier field/deformation submissions, while host completion includes them.

same_near_configuration_while_streaming.note: Continuing material-mask publication conservatively re-deforms/rebuilds the near set, even though the wave time is paused. This is a measured cost/optimization gap, not a zero-build frame claim.

default_radius_static_optical.note: The camera is outside the default near-water sphere; this control does not prove displaced geometry.

animated_coastal_optical.note: 5 km survey camera; no mesh RT consumer. Captured before the final candidate-bound refinement, which has no geometric contribution in this control.

animated_local_flight.note: Real local flight authority and moving camera/stars run concurrently. Not isolated renderer performance or a synthetic presentation-time preview. Captured before final candidate-bound refinement.

packed_final_settled_near.note: Final coefficient-bounded moment shader, same 64-slot/1 km integration configuration. No contemporaneous disabled rerun: not an isolated shader speedup/regression comparison.

packed_final_animated_coast.note: Final coefficient-bounded moment shader; real evolving field, no mesh RT consumer at this survey camera.

native_controls.interpretation: The settled sequential pair adds approximately 2 ms host median feature cost. No speedup, image-aesthetic acceptance, image-identical geometry comparison, whole-system parity or game FPS claim.
